2 x 500 ml Glass Sprayers with removable silicone base and pump with 2 spray modes.

Applicable scene:

  • Ideal for spraying any type of water or oil based liquid.
  • Perfect for cleaning, gardening and pet care.

2 Spray Modes: By rotating the spray nozzle, you can switch between concentrated or diffuse atomization mode, adapting to your specific needs.

DURABLE: Its silicone base provides great adhesion to surfaces, even wet, preventing impact breaks and accidental drops.

Does not leak: Unlike other glass sprayers, the head has a gasket that fits perfectly into the neck of the bottle, preventing any kind of dripping.

Presentation: The product arrives in an elegant box with safe sprayers inside a foam moulding for optimal protection during transport.

STYLISH AND FUNCTIONAL - In addition to their practicality, these sprayers add a touch of sophistication to any workspace or home.
